column1: culture|/ˈkʌltʃər/|n.|文化；习俗；培养|基础|culture-independent|local culture::当地文化;a culture of::一种……的风气|The museum introduces visitors to local culture.::博物馆向访客介绍当地文化。|The team encourages a culture of open discussion.::团队鼓励公开讨论的风气。

civilization|/ˌsɪvələˈzeɪʃən/|n.|文明；文明社会|基础|culture-independent|an ancient civilization::古代文明;modern civilization::现代文明|The course examines the history of an ancient civilization.::这门课程研究一种古代文明的历史。|Water supplies have shaped the development of civilization.::供水条件影响了文明的发展。

custom|/ˈkʌstəm/|n.|习俗；惯例|基础|culture-independent|a local custom::当地习俗;by custom::按惯例|It is a local custom to share food with visitors.::与访客分享食物是当地的习俗。|The book explains customs from several regions.::这本书介绍了几个地区的习俗。

tradition|/trəˈdɪʃən/|n.|传统；惯例|基础|tradition|a family tradition::家庭传统;by tradition::按照传统|Making bread together is a family tradition.::一起做面包是这个家庭的传统。|The festival has a long tradition of music.::这个节日有悠久的音乐传统。

traditional|/trəˈdɪʃənəl/|adj.|传统的；惯常的|基础|tradition|traditional music::传统音乐;a traditional method::传统方法|They played traditional music during the ceremony.::他们在仪式中演奏了传统音乐。|The village still uses a traditional method of building.::村庄仍使用传统的建造方法。

festival|/ˈfestɪvəl/|n.|节日；节庆活动|基础|culture-events|a music festival::音乐节;a spring festival::春季庆典|The town holds a music festival each summer.::镇上每年夏天举办音乐节。|Visitors gathered for the spring festival.::游客聚集在一起参加春季庆典。

celebrate|/ˈseləbreɪt/|v.|庆祝；赞颂|基础|celebrate|celebrate a birthday::庆祝生日;celebrate success::庆祝成功|We will celebrate her birthday at home.::我们将在家里为她庆祝生日。|The exhibition celebrates the work of local artists.::这个展览赞颂了当地艺术家的作品。

celebration|/ˌseləˈbreɪʃən/|n.|庆祝；庆典|基础|celebrate|a family celebration::家庭庆祝活动;in celebration of::为庆祝|The whole street joined the celebration.::整条街的人都参加了庆祝活动。|The concert was held in celebration of the anniversary.::举办这场音乐会是为了庆祝周年纪念日。

ceremony|/ˈserəmoʊni/|n.|典礼；仪式|基础|culture-events|an opening ceremony::开幕式;a graduation ceremony::毕业典礼|The opening ceremony took place in the square.::开幕式在广场举行。|Her family attended the graduation ceremony.::她的家人出席了毕业典礼。

art|/ɑːrt/|n.|艺术；技巧|基础|art|a work of art::艺术作品;the art of::……的技巧|The gallery displays art from different periods.::美术馆展出不同时期的艺术作品。|She understands the art of explaining difficult ideas.::她掌握了讲解复杂观点的技巧。

artist|/ˈɑːrtɪst/|n.|艺术家；美术工作者|基础|art|a local artist::当地艺术家;a young artist::年轻艺术家|A local artist painted the picture on the wall.::一位当地艺术家创作了墙上的画。|The artist used simple lines to suggest movement.::艺术家用简单的线条表现运动。

artistic|/ɑːrˈtɪstɪk/|adj.|艺术的；有艺术才能的|四级|art|artistic expression::艺术表达;artistic ability::艺术才能|The course encourages different forms of artistic expression.::这门课程鼓励不同形式的艺术表达。|Her artistic ability appeared at an early age.::她的艺术才能很早就表现出来了。
music|/ˈmjuːzɪk/|n.|音乐；乐曲|基础|music|listen to music::听音乐;live music::现场音乐|I often listen to music while cooking.::我做饭时常常听音乐。|The festival offers live music in the square.::节日期间，广场上有现场音乐表演。

musical|/ˈmjuːzɪkəl/|adj.; n.|音乐的；有音乐天赋的；音乐剧|基础|music|a musical instrument::乐器;a musical performance::音乐表演|Every child can try a musical instrument.::每个孩子都可以尝试一种乐器。|We went to see a musical at the theater.::我们去剧院看了一部音乐剧。

literature|/ˈlɪtərətʃər/|n.|文学；相关文献|基础|literature|English literature::英语文学;scientific literature::科学文献|She enjoys reading English literature from different centuries.::她喜欢阅读不同时代的英语文学作品。|The team reviewed the scientific literature on the subject.::团队查阅了有关这一主题的科学文献。

literary|/ˈlɪtəreri/|adj.|文学的；与写作有关的|基础|literature|literary criticism::文学评论;a literary work::文学作品|The magazine publishes literary criticism and short stories.::这本杂志刊登文学评论和短篇小说。|The course places each literary work in its historical context.::这门课程把每部文学作品放在其历史背景中理解。
poem|/ˈpoʊəm/|n.|诗；诗篇|基础|poetry|write a poem::写诗;read a poem::读诗|The children wrote a poem about the river.::孩子们写了一首关于河流的诗。|She read the poem aloud to the class.::她向全班朗读了这首诗。
poet|/ˈpoʊət/|n.|诗人|基础|poetry|a famous poet::著名诗人;a young poet::年轻诗人|The poet described winter in a few simple lines.::诗人用几行简单的诗句描写了冬天。|The library invited a young poet to speak.::图书馆邀请了一位年轻诗人演讲。

poetry|/ˈpoʊətri/|n.|诗歌；诗意|四级|poetry|read poetry::读诗;modern poetry::现代诗歌|Reading poetry helps me notice the rhythm of language.::读诗帮助我留意语言的节奏。|The book introduces several forms of modern poetry.::这本书介绍了几种现代诗歌形式。

history|/ˈhɪstəri/|n.|历史；经历；记录|基础|history|local history::地方史;the history of::……的历史|The exhibition tells the history of the town.::展览讲述了这个城镇的历史。|She keeps a detailed history of every repair.::她详细记录了每次维修的情况。

historical|/hɪˈstɔːrɪkəl/|adj.|历史的；与历史有关的|四级|history|historical records::历史记录;a historical novel::历史小说|The museum holds historical records of local trade.::博物馆保存着当地贸易的历史记录。|She is reading a historical novel set by the sea.::她正在读一本以海边为背景的历史小说。

heritage|/ˈherɪtɪdʒ/|n.|遗产；传统|四级|culture-independent|cultural heritage::文化遗产;natural heritage::自然遗产|The old buildings are part of our cultural heritage.::这些老建筑是我们文化遗产的一部分。|The park protects the natural heritage of the region.::这个公园保护着该地区的自然遗产。

religion|/rɪˈlɪdʒən/|n.|宗教；信仰体系|基础|religion|freedom of religion::宗教自由;the study of religion::宗教研究|The course explores the role of religion in history.::这门课程探讨宗教在历史中的作用。|People of different religions attended the event.::不同宗教信仰的人参加了这次活动。

religious|/rɪˈlɪdʒəs/|adj.|宗教的；信教的|基础|religion|religious beliefs::宗教信仰;a religious ceremony::宗教仪式|The museum explains several religious traditions.::博物馆介绍了几种宗教传统。|The building was once used for religious ceremonies.::这座建筑曾用于举行宗教仪式。

ethnic|/ˈeθnɪk/|adj.|民族的；族群的|四级|culture-independent|an ethnic group::一个族群;ethnic diversity::民族多样性|The city is home to several ethnic groups.::这座城市居住着几个不同的族群。|The exhibition reflects the region's ethnic diversity.::展览反映了这个地区的民族多样性。

identity|/aɪˈdentəti/|n.|身份；特征；认同|基础|culture-independent|personal identity::个人身份;a sense of identity::认同感|The story explores questions of personal identity.::这个故事探讨个人身份的问题。|Local traditions can support a sense of identity.::当地传统可以增强认同感。
migrate|/ˈmaɪɡreɪt/|v.|迁移；迁徙|四级|migrate|migrate to::迁往;migrate south::向南迁徙|Many birds migrate south before winter.::许多鸟在冬季到来前向南迁徙。|People may migrate to cities in search of work.::人们可能为寻找工作而迁往城市。

emigrate|/ˈemɪɡreɪt/|v.|移居国外；迁出本国|六级|migrate|emigrate from::从……移居国外;emigrate to::移居到|Her grandparents chose to emigrate after the war.::她的祖父母选择在战后移居国外。|The family emigrated from a small coastal town.::这家人从一个沿海小镇迁居国外。

immigrant|/ˈɪmɪɡrənt/|n.|移民；外来移居者|四级|migrate|an immigrant family::移民家庭;immigrant communities::移民社区|The museum records stories from immigrant families.::博物馆记录了移民家庭的故事。|The program helps each new immigrant find local information.::这个项目帮助每位新移民获取当地信息。

community|/kəˈmjuːnəti/|n.|社区；群体；共同体|四级|culture-independent|a local community::当地社区;a sense of community::群体归属感|The local community helped repair the old hall.::当地社区帮助修缮了老礼堂。|Shared activities can strengthen a sense of community.::共同活动能够增强群体归属感。
